# Interstellar Commerce Commission
The [bold]Interstellar Commerce Commission[/bold] (ICC) is the body through which all interstellar trade is conducted and monitored. Headquartered on [bold]Ruby Colony[/bold] in the Outer Veil, it is officially an independent organization, but in practice it was founded by [textlink="Weyland-Yutani" link="CMUGuideLoreWY"] and is effectively owned and run by the Company.
## Duties - [bold]Licensing[/bold]: every trade vessel and every crew member must hold an ICC license. - [bold]Trade regulation[/bold]: the ICC regulates and enforces trade and keeps the shipping lanes open, and smugglers are its natural enemies. - [bold]Quarantine[/bold]: it enforces quarantine on all cargo bound for Earth, and on planets and whole systems. In the most extreme cases it can order an entire world sterilized, by nuclear bombardment or other means, as it did to the New Earth Colony in 2157. - [bold]Police actions[/bold]: it organizes military operations against colonies declared in flagrant violation of its regulations, such as the ongoing suppression of the revolt on Alexandria. It has no army of its own, so it borrows troops from the nations and corporations of human space, with the Colonial Marines often taking the lead.
## On the Frontier - Every major [textlink="Colonial Marshal" link="CMUGuideLoreCMB"] office has an ICC agent attached, working alongside the Marshals to stop dangerous biological and chemical cargo. - It counts the [textlink="United Americas" link="CMUGuideLoreUA"], the [textlink="Three World Empire" link="CMUGuideLoreTWE"] and Weyland-Yutani among its allies. - It also runs an engineering trade school, with campuses on Earth and Mars, which trains many of the engineers who crew commercial ships.
